provenance.finding: No selection argument becomes trusted internal model policy. No supplied structured request exists on this standalone path.
The pre-brief person policy guard passes; otherwise its English refusal would have been emitted.
Only setter adopts fresh parsed model understanding when request is absent. humanFactSelection has validated boolean type.

The unique exact Russian refusal proves fresh humanFactSelection was true. This final plan was not persisted before a writer claim; non-stream provider body was not captured, so its value is branch-proven rather than directly read back.

rootCause: The model-facing structured field was an undescribed boolean and the brief instruction did not distinguish a PERSON choosing facts before writing from assistant research/verification/saved-artifact readback. A fresh semantic true became an outstanding person-selection constraint.
changeBoundary: Only schema description plus generic brief semantics; no new fields, boolean coercion, phrase routing, guard changes, automatic retries or paid calls.

claimLimit: The schema description and controlled consumer tests cannot guarantee how a real model interprets a future prompt. Root must rerun the natural request and an explicit person-selection case.
